member.name: T:Alkami.Utilities.Cryptography.AsymmetricEncryption
member.summary: The AsymmetricEncryption contains an Encryptor and Decryptor that can be used to security encrypt large amounts of data securely. This was originally made for log encryption. It is currently only used by log encryption.
member.remarks:
Since asymmetric encryption is only designed to encrypt small amounts of data, encryption on the majority of the payload is done using a symmetric encryption provider using random Key/IV. The certificate and asymmetric encryption is used to only encrypt the Key/IV. The following table documents the format of the encrypted string.
Name Data Type Encoding Encryption Remarks
Thumbprint length ushort
The length of the Thumbprint byte array.
Thumbprint byte array ASCII
The thumbprint identifies the certificate that was used to encrypt the cipher. That certificate will be needed to decrypt the encrypted cargo.
Cipher length ushort
The length of the Cipher byte array.
Cipher byte array ASCII Encrypted with certificate The cipher contains the Key and IV that was used to encrypt the cargo. It is encrypted with the certificate.
Encrypted Cargo length ushort
The length of the encrypted Cargo byte array.
Cargo byte array UTF8 Symmetric encrypted using random Key/IV stored in Cipher Contains the encrypted cargo that was encrypted using symmetric encryption using a random Key and IV that has been stored in the Cipher.
Cargo length ushort
The original length of the Cargo byte array before encryption.
